name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation & Key Account Leader | AI Agents and Workflow Automation
summary: Implementation and account leader with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, owning customer relationships from signature through go-live, adoption, and expansion. Led an onboarding team of up to 20 at Wix while personally launching 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets, and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner reseller network at Birdeye. As founder of Solenzo, designs and tunes LLM-based agents and automation for home-services businesses (lead handling, booking, follow-up), evaluates AI output against rubric-based standards, and works directly in APIs, SQL, and code steps when an integration breaks. Equally comfortable in a C-suite review and a hands-on troubleshooting session.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Design where AI fits into home-services businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), decomposing manual workflows into agent architectures with custom logic and deciding where a person stays in the loop.
Evaluate AI-generated responses in client automation systems and built rubric-based grading criteria for the SEO audit process, labeling data personally to score outputs against defined standards.
Architected a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system covering lead capture and routing, qualification, appointment booking with reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding, reactivation, and review generation.
Integrate client CRMs and sites through Zapier, Make, and n8n, writing Python and JavaScript in custom code steps and SQL for BigQuery/GA4 and Power BI data models.
Translate business owners' loosely defined goals into precise prompts, agent instructions, and technical configurations, then train their teams hands-on.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead flow, funnel progression, and campaign ROI, and report results with clear recommendations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, coordinating execution across internal departments as strategic lead.
Built performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Guided customers through complex technical setup of reputation and marketing-automation tools, including Birdeye's listings-syndication solution at the core of the channel offer.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance to find adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Turned partner feedback into structured, prioritized input for Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, and led the sales team.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and tightened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery timelines for a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Drove process improvements for a new Wix vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including hiring, onboarding, and training new team members.
Defined the CRM fields for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive (Sales & Implementation Planning)
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, advising C-suite executives on operational system design.
Troubleshot workflow design and resolved technical issues during setup alongside implementation teams, escalating account risk to leadership early.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
